description:
Manage meetings, documents, forms… right from your pocket, with no trackers
Create and quickly access your Framadate (scheduling polls), Framapads (collaborative documents), Framapdf (PDF editing/signing), Framatalk (video conferencing), Framagenda (de-Googled calendars), and other online tools.

The renowned suite of free, ethical, open-source web services - provided by the non-profit organization Framasoft and built without data exploitation - now has its own official app!

With the Framasoft app, you can:
• Open links to any Framasoft service (polls, pads, etc.) directly within the app.
• View your history to find links to the Framasoft tools you’ve used.
• Bookmark the services you want to access quickly.
• Keep your data secure: there’s no need to create a new account; all information related to the app is stored locally on your device.
• Easily access Framasoft’s various projects, educational websites, and general information.

Framasoft is a non-profit organization serving the public interest; it offers these tools for free, supported entirely by donations.

With over 20 years of experience in the field of free and open-source software, Framasoft has spent more than a decade providing alternatives to help "degooglify" the Internet.

Its mission is to foster digital emancipation and showcase alternatives to the harmful tools offered by major tech giants. Every month, more than 2 million people use the 30+ online services provided by the organization - making Framasoft the world’s largest non-commercial host of web services.
